description: The pages waiting in a wiki space's trash: each page that was deleted (the pages that went with it are counted in 'pages'), when, by whom, and 'purgeAt' — when it is deleted for good, 30 days after. 'backInPlace' says whether restore_wiki_page would put it back under its old parent ('parentTitle') or, that parent being gone, at the top of the space. The project's administrators see the whole trash ('canPurge': true); anybody else who may write in the space sees only the pages they deleted themselves and may still restore.

spaceKey.description: The space key — every project has one, keyed like the project.
